**5.** (15 pt) Consider the simple linear regression model

$$Y_i = \beta_0 + \beta_1 X_i + \epsilon_i$$

**(a)** (10 pts) Show that minimizing the sum of squared residuals leads to the following least squares coefficient estimates:

$$\hat{\beta}_1 = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^{n}(X_i - \bar{X})(Y_i - \bar{Y})}{\sum_{i=1}^{n}(X_i - \bar{X})^2}$$

$$\hat{\beta}_0 = \bar{Y} - \hat{\beta}_1 \bar{X}$$

where $\bar{X} = \sum_{i=1}^{n} X_i / n$ and $\bar{Y} = \sum_{i=1}^{n} Y_i / n$. 


**(b)** (5 pts) Show that $\hat{\beta}_0$ and $\hat{\beta}_1$ are unbiased estimators.
